    toc: true
    toc_depth: 2
    theme: flatly

  profile: "smoke"
  root: "."
---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE)
Sys.setenv(VALIDATION_CALIBRATION_ROOT = normalizePath(params$root, mustWork = TRUE))
source(file.path(params$root, "R", "00_paths.R"))
activate_local_lib()
source_vc("05_report_helpers.R")
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
profile <- params$profile
calibration <- read_validation_table("validation_calibration_summary", profile)
split <- read_validation_table("validation_split_stability", profile)
runtime <- read_validation_table("validation_runtime_projection", profile)
diagnostics <- read_validation_table("validation_diagnostics", profile)
```

# Executive Tables

```{r}
global_tab <- calibration |>
  filter(scenario_family == "global_binary", is_true_null) |>
  group_by(n, within_r) |>
  summarise(
    attempted = sum(attempted),
    fit_failure_rate = mean(fit_failure_rate, na.rm = TRUE),
    retention_rate = mean(retention_rate, na.rm = TRUE),
    rejection_rate = mean(rejection_rate_unconditional, na.rm = TRUE),
    null_coverage = mean(null_coverage, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )
kable_if_rows(global_tab, "Global-null summary")
```

```{r}
partial_tab <- calibration |>
  filter(scenario_family == "partial_binary", is_true_null) |>
  group_by(n, between_r, group) |>
  summarise(
    attempted = sum(attempted),
    fit_failure_rate = mean(fit_failure_rate, na.rm = TRUE),
    retention_rate = mean(retention_rate, na.rm = TRUE),
    rejection_rate = mean(rejection_rate_unconditional, na.rm = TRUE),
    null_coverage = mean(null_coverage, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )
kable_if_rows(partial_tab, "Partial-null false-attribution summary")
```

```{r}
split_tab <- split |>
  group_by(scenario_family, n) |>
  summarise(
    estimable_split_rate = sum(estimable_split_count) / sum(split_count),
    median_p_value_cv = median(p_value_cv, na.rm = TRUE),
    median_p_value_iqr = median(p_value_iqr, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_retention_rate = mean(retention_rate, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )
kable_if_rows(split_tab, "Split-stability summary")
```

# Diagnostics

```{r}
diag_tab <- diagnostics |>
  summarise(
    jobs = n(),
    successful = sum(fit_success, na.rm = TRUE),
    failed = sum(!fit_success, na.rm = TRUE),
    median_runtime_sec = median(runtime_sec, na.rm = TRUE),
    lambda_boundary_rate = mean(selected_lambda_at_path_boundary, na.rm = TRUE),
    all_zero_rate = mean(all_zero_exposure, na.rm = TRUE),
    median_boot_success_rate = median(boot_success_rate, na.rm = TRUE)
  )
kable_if_rows(diag_tab, "Overall diagnostics")
```

```{r}
kable_if_rows(runtime, "Runtime projection")
```
